Existing web binding with pending receipt → API Key discovery/test/save/chat/reload via production HTTP; independent login/readiness-gated binding/test; local receipt recovery without remote probe; synthetic services only; persisted Chrome No tab error through authenticated extension protocol → explicit local lease release with unknown outcome → ready independent page binding → one new chat, no old replay; browsing empty/web/API bindings does not dirty configuration, edits persist across tabs and discard restores saved values
Known model trigger variants, click-only activation, delayed exact options, hidden/disabled/ambiguous trigger rejection, no silent current fallback, stream handoff boundary
Exact nested family match and verified thinking enumeration/restoration

manualChain.steps: 新建临时 AIKI_BOOK_DATA → npm start → 验证窗口/后端就绪与 writer.lock → 关闭窗口：仅隐藏，进程/写锁仍在 → 双击托盘图标恢复同一窗口 → 托盘右键选择退出 ALLMIND：进程排空与 writer.lock 释放 → 同数据目录再次启动并从托盘退出
manualChain.note: 前实例完全退出后数秒内立即重启可能出现一次瞬态 pet:// 加载 ERR_FAILED(-2)（见 baseline.json 观察记录）；等待完整退出后再重启即可
